note: Hand-curated declarations (spec analyses/M557_spec.md Rev 2). Coverage is checked against the evidenceLedger checks and a deterministic scan of the payload keys; the ingestion stage never edits this file.

exclusions.cadenceControlled: a boolean flag that a specification adjusts for cadence, not a control
exclusions.referenceIsControl: a boolean flag on a reference row
exclusions.demandControlledRegen: a demand-controlled estimate, not a control
exclusions.conditionControlledQuantiles: a condition-controlled estimate, not a control
exclusions.socControlSurface: a SoC control surface (an analysis object), not a validation control
exclusions.controlSlowToSlowerDrives: the drive count of the slow-to-slower control, covered by its own claim

claims.algorithmAxis: the chain includes the primary detector

auditNotes: out-of-time for fitting only: the specification was selected on the full data

claims.channelAxis: same raw channels (current, voltage, pack temperature)
claims.settledBy: Director after blind audit (analyses/M557_audit_result.json): nested specifications fitted to the same response proxy on the same drives; the pre-registered expectation shared_raw_input is recorded as not met

claims.nullMechanism: where the pack charges normally below the knee no dissipation can occur, so the diverted power the reference method reports there is the method's upward bias; it is a bias reference, not a null test of the headline
auditNotes: bias reference, not a null: coastKw is 88 % of ceilingKw by construction
the two sets contain different drives

claims.nullMechanism: the same thinning emulator applied to drives that are already at the slow interval, to separate the emulator's own effect from the fast-to-slow difference; a non-unit ratio is the emulator effect
auditNotes: one-sided by construction: thinning must lower throughput
the pool and control drives may overlap (see poolControlOverlap)

claims.nullMechanism: peak keys are expected to move in one direction under thinning (a maximum cannot rise when samples are removed), so movement is the expected outcome and its sign is the check; no null is expected
auditNotes: one-sided by construction: a maximum cannot rise when samples are removed

claims.nullMechanism: a drop of the residual autocorrelation after removing a slow mean also occurs under pure AR(1) in the harness, so the control is a reference for the drop and cannot by itself identify seasonal structure
auditNotes: estimates residual autocorrelation, not the slope

claims.nullMechanism: as for the cell-spread control: the drop under pure AR(1) is the reference
auditNotes: estimates residual autocorrelation, not the slope
cannot discriminate: the autocorrelation before the slow-mean removal is already about zero

claims.nullMechanism: specification S0 is the cluster-robust OLS used as the reference slope; it is a specification reference, not a null control
claims.settledBy: Director after blind audit: nested specification fitted to the same response proxy on the same drives

claims.nullMechanism: a pre-registered decision rule on the spread of the specification slopes; its outcome is a decision, not a null result, and it adds no data or fit, so it is circular with its target by construction
claims.algorithmAxis: decision rule on the specification set
auditNotes: pre-registered decision rule; circular with its target by construction
